agentic AI.author: carnage4life.bsky.social
agentic AI.text: One thing Obama said about AI that bears repeating is training agentic AI to hack websites and using AI to search for a cancer cure or solve the energy crisis are unrelated. Frontier lab CEOs treating these as intertwined are being disingenuous. It’s a choice to do both.

agentic AI.text: Silicon Valley is shifting away from chatbot queries toward a future filled with resource-intensive agentic AI—and it's driving the data center buildout.

agentic internet.text: "You can cure cancer and solve energy without letting AI roam free on the internet." — Obama drawing a sharp line between narrow AI tools and unconstrained agentic systems
